Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a full piano roll, MIDI event editing, hardware input and output, and local SoundFont audition. Includes same-PC ensemble song sharing, MIDI Workbench, Soulweaver Studio, Showmaster, the native Performance HUD toggle, and MP4 concert capture.
Changelog: Added opt-in same-PC song sharing. When the conductor adds a MIDI, followers on the same Windows account and Ensemble stage receive a copy in their active Ensemble playlist. Each follower keeps their own playlist and identical MIDI files are added once.
